reader.requirement: At --std 85 a RENAMES ... THRU entry must be refused when the area of data-name-3 begins to the left of the area of data-name-2 or does not end to the right of data-name-2's end (so data-name-3 subordinate to, or coinciding with, data-name-2 is refused), measured on storage positions including redefining items, while a data-name-3 that begins at data-name-2's start and ends after it is legal.

reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness pb1283_renames_legal covers only legal THRU windows; data-name-3 to the left, subordinate to data-name-2, data-name-2 subordinate to data-name-3, and redefining operands are not exercised by it

probes.printed: error COBOL2740: 'X' RENAMES C THRU A: the beginning of data-name-3 precedes the beginning of data-name-2
probes.expected: refusal: data-name-3 begins to the left

probes.printed: error COBOL2740: 'X' RENAMES G THRU B: the end of data-name-3 does not follow the end of data-name-2
probes.expected: refusal: data-name-3 (B) subordinate to data-name-2 (G), ends at G's end

probes.printed: error COBOL2740: 'X' RENAMES G THRU A: the end of data-name-3 does not follow the end of data-name-2
probes.expected: refusal: data-name-3 (A) subordinate to data-name-2, ending before it
legal: A THRU G (G begins where A begins and ends after it) = ABCD; B THRU C = CDEF

probes.printed: error COBOL2740 for 66 X RENAMES B THRU C (C REDEFINES A, left of B); 66 Y RENAMES C THRU B accepted
probes.expected: refusal only for the window whose data-name-3 begins left of data-name-2, measured on the redefining item's storage
legal: A22 (a subordinate of a redefining group, positions 2-4) THRU B (positions 5-6) = BCD12

reader.notes: ScreenRenamesWindowOrder requires start3 >= start2 and end3 > end2 on the one storage-offset function, where a redefiner sits at its target's offset; both halves of the rule and its consequence (data-name-3 not subordinate to data-name-2) hold at --std 85. Diagnostics quote the 2023 wording (cosmetic).

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85: x1 (C REDEFINES A, same size: A THRU C and C THRU A, coincident areas) -> two COBOL2740 'the end of data-name-3 does not follow the end of data-name-2', right by the text ('must be to the right'); x2 (H REDEFINES G: H1 positions 1-2 THRU G2 positions 2-4, data-name-3 earlier in entry order but its area begins right of and ends after data-name-2's) -> exit 0 [ABCD], measured on areas as the rule says, not on entry order; x3 (U THRU S, signed SEPARATE items, S left of U) -> COBOL2740 'beginning of data-name-3 precedes'; x4 (S PIC S9(3) LEADING SEPARATE THRU U PIC S99 TRAILING SEPARATE across an OCCURS 2 group, and U THRU V) -> exit 0 [-012TT07+|07+V], the separate sign characters counted in each area. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.11.3 SR8 the text is in SR8.
